title: Daq backdrop
description: A fixed, window-filling media layer behind the whole page (the original's liquid WebGL), overlaid with a faint 12-column hairline grid and a vignette into the page colour at the bottom. Transparent sections show it; solid ones cover it, so it appears and disappears as you scroll.
notes: place it first on the page; give the sections after it position: relative (all daq blocks are) so they paint above it
the media slot fills the window like object-fit cover; empty, it is a blue-grey muted surface with a soft glow wash
